questions.question: Which molecule is considered the universal energy currency for most cellular processes?

questions.question: A science experiment involves placing yeast cells in two sealed containers, A and B. options.text: Yeast performs only aerobic respiration in the presence of oxygen.
options.explanation: Yeast can perform both aerobic and anaerobic respiration.

options.text: Yeast performs only anaerobic respiration in the absence of oxygen.
options.explanation: Yeast can perform both aerobic and anaerobic respiration.

options.text: Yeast can perform both aerobic and anaerobic respiration, producing different byproducts depending on oxygen availability.

options.text: The presence of carbon dioxide indicates only aerobic respiration occurred in both containers.
options.explanation: The presence of ethanol in Container B indicates anaerobic respiration occurred.

questions.explanation: In Container A (with oxygen), yeast performs aerobic respiration, producing CO2. In Container B (without oxygen), yeast performs anaerobic respiration (alcoholic fermentation), producing CO2 and ethanol.
